title: Know the account. See the opening.
intro: A proposed revenue workspace for Vega: map carriers, MGAs and self-insured organizations, preserve buying-committee coverage and turn verified changes into timely seller actions.
notice: All organizations, committee coverage, dates and signals are synthetic. This workspace supports account research and sales timing only. It does not process individual claims or make coverage, liability or payout decisions.

experiments.name: Committee coverage before outreach
experiments.hypothesis: A reviewed map of claims, operations and procurement makes discovery more useful.
experiments.control: One contact and a company description
experiments.treatment: Verified roles, coverage gaps and a specific discovery question
experiments.allocation: Compare matched carrier and MGA cohorts

experiments.name: Conference follow-through
experiments.hypothesis: A clear owner and agreed next step reduce forgotten event conversations.
experiments.treatment: Reviewed notes, deduplication and owner acceptance
experiments.primary: Held follow-up conversations within the observation window
experiments.allocation: Assign at account level to avoid overlapping rep outreach

roadmap.title: Build a finite market map
roadmap.body: Agree on the carrier, MGA, broker and self-insured universe. Define account identity, buying roles and source freshness with sales. Pilot one segment.
roadmap.measure: Account coverage, verified buying roles and research gaps

roadmap.title: Connect changes to owned actions
roadmap.body: Add verified renewal, RFP and program-launch signals. Preserve the existing account owner and build a conference follow-up queue with acceptance receipts.
roadmap.measure: Fresh signals, accepted actions and duplicate outreach avoided

roadmap.title: Support the long buying cycle
roadmap.body: Schedule re-engagement from a known review window rather than a generic cadence. Compare qualified conversations and progress by cohort with sales leadership.
roadmap.measure: Held discovery, committee coverage and next-step completion
